data.author: ai-agent
data.comment: Measured-sweep attempt (AC3): ran `slot_benchmark --slots 3 --concurrency 3 --prompt-tokens 2000` against the live proxy on 2026-10-20 ~12:10. The shared proxy was under heavy multi-agent load (5 concurrent sessions, 52 distinct sessions/5min, 2 audits + 4 herdr panes holding local leases). Under live contention + prefill serialisation every benchmark turn-1 request stalled at 600-760s (timeout 1200s) and llama-server stopped answering health probes; I aborted with SIGINT and the harness restored the config (sha256 6eec5656...) and I performed a controlled start-proxy.sh --restart. State verified healthy afterwards: status=healthy, slots=2, parallel=2. Conclusion: a clean N=3/N=4 sweep needs a quiet/maintenance window; deferred to a follow-up item (same harness, exact command recorded in the doc). No production slot-count change is made by this item (AC5).
